## Tech Stack

- Pure markdown — no build tools, no templating engine
- Git for version control

## Conventions

- README uses GitHub-flavored markdown
- Tables for structured data (commands, layers, profiles)
- Code blocks for shell commands
- Structure tree uses ASCII art indentation

## Architecture Rules

- README is an entry point, not a manual — each subsection max 10 lines with doc pointers
- Hard line cap: 250 lines
- All claims must be verifiable against actual repo files
- Section order preserved: problem, solution, quick start, structure, upstream, architecture reference

## Write Boundaries

- `README.md` (root of repo) — the only file written by this contract
